title: Mehendi Outfit Ideas: Comfortable, Colourful and Camera-Ready
excerpt: Mehendi outfit ideas for brides' friends and family – colours, fabrics and comfortable styles that look great in photos.
body:
The mehendi is the most colourful, relaxed function of an Indian wedding. You will be sitting, dancing and getting henna applied – so comfort matters as much as style.

## Choose bright, happy colours

Yellow, green, orange, pink and turquoise are traditional mehendi colours. Prints and florals look cheerful in photos.

## Pick breathable fabrics

Cotton and hand block printed fabrics keep you cool, especially at afternoon or outdoor events.

## Keep sleeves practical

Short or three-quarter sleeves are best, so they do not smudge your henna while it dries.

## Outfit ideas

- **A cotton kurta set** with a light dupatta – easy and elegant.
- **A flowy Anarkali** in a pastel shade for a dreamy look.
- **A printed co-ord set** for a modern, fun feel at a casual mehendi.

## Accessories

Pair your outfit with oxidised jhumkas, bangles and flat juttis or sandals. Skip heavy jewellery on your hands – they will be covered in henna.

## Planning tip

If the mehendi is abroad in cooler weather, choose a fuller-sleeve kurta and carry a shawl.
